name: How long does a main drain cleaning typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a main drain cleaning typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a main drain cleaning service can vary depending on the complexity of the clog and the method used. A straightforward blockage cleared with a snake might take 1 to 2 hours. However, more severe obstructions, such as extensive tree root intrusion or significant buildup requiring hydro-jetting, could extend the service to 3-4 hours or even longer. Our technicians will provide an estimated timeframe after an initial assessment, taking into account the specifics of your system and the nature of the blockage. We prioritize thoroughness to ensure the problem is fully resolved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleaning time varies; simple clogs may take 1-2 hours, while severe blockages like tree roots could take 3-4 hours or more depending on complexity.
